subject: Mathematics

source.topic: Numbers, operations and relationships: Mental maths (number range 20)
source.subtopic: Order a given set of numbers 1-16 (weeks 1-2), 1-17 (weeks 3-4), 1-18 (weeks 5-6), 1-20 (weeks 7-8): ascending and descending, left to right

show.line: Line them up! Four, nine, thirteen, seventeen. Smallest on the left, biggest on the right.

rounds.prompt: Smallest to greatest. Six, eleven, fourteen, and then?
Which is the smallest? Fifteen, eight or sixteen?
Greatest to smallest. Seventeen, thirteen, ten, and then?
Which number is between twelve and fourteen?
Which is greater, sixteen or thirteen? Say it.
Which row goes from smallest to greatest?
rounds.praise: Two, seven, twelve, seventeen. In order!

hints: Find the smallest first. Put it on the left.
Teen numbers are bigger than numbers under ten.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! Smallest to greatest. Fifteen, nine, twelve.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! That is greatest to smallest. Nine, twelve, fifteen.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's start with the smallest. Nine, then twelve, then fifteen!

parent_line: Can put numbers to 17 in order, going up and going down.
